notes: When you eliminate a debt it now leaves your active list and moves into a new Paid Off Debts section right below it. Your debt list actually gets shorter as you win.
Each eliminated debt shows what the fight cost you: the original balance, the interest you paid, and how many months it took.
The section is collapsed by default and shows running totals - everything eliminated, total interest paid, and accounts closed.

Paid-off debts stay editable. If you use a card again (say, a 0% balance transfer), edit it and it returns to your active list with its full history intact - and paying it off a second time earns a fresh celebration.
